an4.255:1.3: idha bhikkhave ekacco attanā jarādhammo samāno jarādhammaṃ yeva pariyesati.
an4.255:1.4: attanā vyādhidhammo samāno vyādhidhammaṃ yeva pariyesati.
an4.255:1.5: attanā maraṇadhammo samāno maraṇadhammaṃ yeva pariyesati.
an4.255:1.6: attanā saṃkilesadhammo samāno saṃkilesadhammaṃ yeva pariyesati.
an4.255:2.3: idha bhikkhave ekacco attanā jarādhammo samāno jarādhamme ādīnavaṃ viditvā ajaraṃ anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ nibbānaṃ pariyesati.
an4.255:2.4: attanā vyādhidhammo samāno vyādhidhamme ādīnavaṃ viditvā avyādhiṃ anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ nibbānaṃ pariyesati.
an4.255:2.5: attanā maraṇadhammo samāno maraṇadhamme ādīnavaṃ viditvā amataṃ anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ nibbānaṃ pariyesati.
an4.255:2.6: attanā saṃkilesadhammo samāno saṃkilesadhamme ādīnavaṃ viditvā asaṃkiliṭṭhaṃ anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ nibbānaṃ pariyesati.
